snippet.title: "Into the Unknown" | Alpha Level 2 Gameplay Reveal (UE5 indie FPS) "TAS Facility"
snippet.description:
Here is the full alpha playthrough of the second level of the game I'm working on. The game will be in the style of Black Mesa and Half-Life, with an engaging story and many different levels, varying in length from just a few seconds to several hours.

Feel free to join the INTO THE UNKNOWN Discord group: [https://discord.gg/RzjPvUvSCr](https://discord.gg/RzjPvUvSCr)

Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/user/Disastrous_Plum176/
Discord: https://discord.gg/3hd4JSNk
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@intotheunknowngame
